description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to voice wake triggers and locale normalization within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: VoiceWakeHelpersTests
classes.description: A structure containing test cases for voice wake triggers sanitization and locale normalization functions.

methods.name: sanitize triggers trims and drops empty
methods.description: Tests that whitespace and empty strings are correctly trimmed and removed in voice wake triggers.

methods.name: sanitize triggers falls back to defaults
methods.description: Tests that an array of empty or whitespace-only triggers falls back to default triggers.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word length
methods.description: Ensures that individual words in triggers do not exceed the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word count
methods.description: Ensures that the number of triggers does not exceed the maximum allowed count.

methods.name: normalize locale strips collation
methods.description: Checks that locale identifiers are correctly normalized by removing collation extensions.

methods.name: normalize locale strips unicode extensions
methods.description: Ensures that unicode extension tags are removed from locale identifiers during normalization.
